firstMessage.rawMarkdown:
We are pre-registering three confirmatory experiments for our Paper Track submission, before any of them has started. The plan covers only these experiments. Analyses of runs that already existed are exploratory and will be labelled as such in the paper. The plan will be published with the paper, and all three experiments will be reported whatever the result.

Plan SHA-256: 72e3fb303b86bbbbe5d99aadc8d0a62bbf26eca089170ffe690b359df27e1ebd

We also commit to a snapshot of our draft as of today, covering the exploratory analyses. It will be published with the paper.

Draft SHA-256: 32c4f5910aab4d1a59532e9ed4b0b82aaaf71f3b1e04819a51b58c69eb072edf
